scope: Reviewed UniProt EC 3.1.4 exact-EC distribution and candidate metal-independent PDE split counts after APH tier-2 apply.

method.source: UniProt REST reviewed:true query counts and cursor sample
method.notes: Counts are source-strategy evidence only. They do not admit labels and do not count EC as a mechanism corroborator.

broad_distribution_sample.interpretation: The reviewed EC 3.1.4 surface is dominated by generic 3.1.4.- records, phospholipase/phosphodiesterase boundary rows, sphingomyelinases, ENPP/pyrophosphatase rows, and small exact cyclic-nucleotide subfamilies.

decision.next_safe_action: Do not retry broad EC/name PDE windows as a mass-growth path. A safe PDE lane needs a new mechanism-bearing source wall beyond exact EC/name counts, or the automation should pivot to a different high-yield family/source-tier strategy.
